correctness.rationale: The *repaired final* claim explicitly assumes the earlier exact affine-Crofton vertex law rather than asserting new discovery. Conditioned invariant measure gives joint Gaussian offset density 1_{0<t<max|G_i|}/m_d; the known section count is v_d(k)=k(2d-k-1) for k exceedances. For fixed x∈(0,1), k_d/d→1-sqrt(1-x), the corresponding half-normal quantile tends in L1 to sqrt2 erfinv(sqrt(1-x)), and m_d/sqrt(2log d)→1. Hence the new exact quadratic-scale tail constant follows. For any fixed s>0, v_d(R_d(t))/d²→1-erf(t/sqrt2)²; integrable bound 2^s Q(t)^min(s,1) permits dominated convergence over t and yields entire positive moment family. The s=1 constant 2/sqrtpi is consistent with the earlier exact mean, which is credited not claimed. Finite checker only corroborates Crofton sampling; no finite experiment is used for asymptotic proof.
